subject: FoilTech: eligibility & contract exceptions for Private deployment
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@foiltech.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Interest to move forward — FoilTech SOW & questions on export controls

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We've gone internal and are ready to move forward pending two things: (1) confirmation that Redwood can support a Private deployment for our satellite edge use cases, and (2) an expedited review of any export control / sanctions eligibility given some of our downstream partners are outside North America.

I attached a purchase order and SOW draft (see attachments). Procurement and legal are asking specifically:
- Can you confirm Redwood's policy on customers in the satellite / comms sector (we're a commercial satellite integrator)?
- Are there export control restrictions (ECCN) or sanctions checks we should expect in contracting?
- We're also asking for a pricing concession (25% discount) and a data-residency clause to keep customer data in a dedicated VPC in us-east.

Can we get a short call this week? Procurement@foiltech.com is on copy.

Best,
Ari Kaplan
Director, Strategic Programs
FoilTech Inc.

Attachment: FoilTech_PO_20260705.pdf, FoilTech_SOW_v2.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@foiltech.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-05T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Interest to move forward — FoilTech SOW & questions on export controls

Hi Ari —

Appreciate the materials. Short answers up front: we can support Private deployments and we do run standard sanctions/KYC checks as part of onboarding. There may be additional export control steps depending on end use — we need some intake info from you to classify.

Can you fill out the quick intake I attached (company registration, ultimate beneficial owners, list of relevant end customers/regions, and an intended end-use statement)? That will let Security and Legal triage the ECCN and sanctions posture.

Also looping Monica (deal desk) and Vivek (security) to start the intake + screening.

If you can get the intake back today/tomorrow we can aim for a review and an internal exec decision by early next week.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.inference

Date: 2026-07-05T15:20:00Z

Laura —

Thanks — intake form completed and attached. A few clarifications: we supply commercial satellite terminals and software to international partners (APAC, LATAM, ME). None of our customers are on sanction lists to our knowledge, but we do operate in regulated markets.

Procurement would like Redwood to accept the data residency clause in SOW section 6.3 and to include a standard indemnity carveout for export-control violations. They're also pushing for a 25% first-year discount to meet budget.

Attached: completed intake form, PO. Happy to hop on a call if you prefer.

Regards,
Ari

Date: 2026-07-06T08:45:00Z
Subject: INTERNAL: FoilTech — deal desk intake & ask for exec exception (pricing + residency)

Team —

Quick summary from intake: FoilTech is a commercial satellite integrator, operates in APAC/LATAM/ME, provided UBOs and registration. They are asking for: 25% first-year discount, acceptance of a data-residency clause (customer-managed VPC in us-east), and specific indemnity language around export controls.

Risk notes:
- Security flagged potential ECCN concerns due to terminal software (Vivek to confirm).
- Legal will need to review indemnity carveouts.

Asks:
- I recommend escalating for executive approval on non-standard pricing and data-residency commitment. We can consider a capped discount and conditional approval pending security/legal signoff.
- HubSpot deal link is below; this should trigger a commercial exception if approved.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/FT-2026-099

Monica Patel
Deal Desk Manager

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-06T12:12:00Z
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: FoilTech — deal desk intake & ask for exec exception (pricing + residency)

Laura / Monica —

I ran a sanctions screen and looked at the intake. Results: no hits on SDN/OFAC lists and clean company registration. However, the product described (satellite terminal firmware + edge orchestration) could fall under dual-use classifications depending on export jurisdiction and the intended end uses. We need ECCN classification from Legal + an end-user certificate to mitigate risk.

Recommendations:
- Require an End-User Certificate (EUC) and written attestation of no military end-use.
- Approve Private deployment only (no hosted API) with encryption-at-rest and restricted admin access.
- Legal to review indemnity redlines; do not accept unlimited indemnity for export-control violations.
- If execs want to proceed on pricing, tie discount to milestone payments and confirm EUC + signed PO before provisioning.

Attachment: sanctions_screening_report_20260706.pdf

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>
Cc: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-07T09:00:00Z
Subject: REQUEST: Exec approval for pricing & residency exception — FoilTech (FT-2026-099)

Markus —

We have a ready-to-sign FoilTech deal (SOW + PO attached) but they require two non-standard items that trigger a commercial exception:
1) 25% first-year discount requested (procurement) — our deal desk recommends up to 20% as a stretch.
2) Data-residency clause and Private deployment requirement (they will not accept hosted).

Security (Vivek) has completed an initial screen (attached). No sanctions hits but potential ECCN exposure. Vivek recommends an EUC and that deployment be limited to Private with restricted admin access. Legal (Rafael) will redline indemnity to limit Redwood exposure.

Decision requested: please approve or deny an exception for non-standard pricing (proposed 20% cap) and acceptance of data-residency clause contingent on EUC + Legal redlines. Time sensitivity: FoilTech wants provisioned infrastructure within 5 business days; losing speed risks the buyer deciding to go with a competitor.

Summary of options:
- Approve 20% discount + Private deployment with EUC & Legal signoff (recommended).
- Approve up to 15% discount, escalate further if Legal identifies ECCN risk.
- Deny discount and hold to standard terms (likely to lose deal).

Thanks — need a response by EOD to meet their timeline.

Laura Bennett
Account Executive

Attachment: FoilTech_SOW_v2.pdf

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-07T13:47:00Z
Subject: Re: REQUEST: Exec approval for pricing & residency exception — FoilTech (FT-2026-099)

Thanks Laura — good write-up. I approve a limited commercial exception with the following constraints:

1) Discount: approve up to 15% first-year discount only. Any deeper concessions must return to me with updated risk/IRR analysis.
2) Residency & deployment: approve Private deployment in us-east with the standard encryption and access restrictions. No hosted credentials to be issued.
3) Required preconditions (must be satisfied prior to provisioning):
   - Signed End-User Certificate (EUC) and procurement PO received.
   - Legal (Rafael) to finalize indemnity redlines limiting export-control liability to the counterparty.
   - Security (Vivek) to confirm ECCN classification or acceptable mitigation in writing.

Monica / Laura — proceed to prepare contract redlines and DocuSign with the above constraints. Rafael/Vivek, please confirm when your signoffs are complete so we can close by end of next week.

Markus Klein
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
